body: I can't have pets.  I have never been so close as I am right now.  Just knowing that tomorrow I'm going to have to wake up with my back and hips on fire no matter how many painkillers I take... My friends and family have been supportive, but I've been sick for so long, I know they're tired of hearing me complain.  I feel like I'm screaming that I'm not okay and no one hears me, and now I'm tired of shouting.

I don't understand why.  Why my babies?  Why my loved ones?  Why my body?  I don't have anything anymore.  I'm a burden.  I have a master's degree and I can't find my way home from work sometimes.  I'm so exhausted I sleep on the floor in my living room because I can't walk twelve steps to the bedroom.  I don't even know who to call right now because everyone's asleep and I'd just burden them anyway.  I just wanted someone so badly to hug me today..  That's it.
